title: Person: Dante
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Dante

anchor.prefix:
ead. We saw him lying upon the catafalque. A wail of sorrow went up from the people.

 —Parnell! Parnell! He is dead!

 They fell upon their knees, moaning in sorrow.

 And he saw
anchor.suffix:
in a maroon velvet dress and with a green velvet mantle hanging from her shoulders walking proudly and silently past the people who knelt by the water’s edge.

 A great fire, bank
